The Counter

Straight Off The Tray

A rolling counter of Turkish home cooking — hearty stews, bright salads and a proper pudding, plated fresh most days.

Counter classic

Slow-Cooked Lamb Stew

Lamb simmered low in a rich tomato and pepper sauce, served with bulgur pilaf and a side salad.

Home-style

Chicken & Potato Stew

Tender pulled chicken alongside a roasted potato and pepper stew — proper home cooking, by the tray.

Bulgur salad

Kısır

Fine bulgur tossed with herbs and pepper, finished with a pomegranate molasses drizzle.

Counter side

Baba Ganoush & Roast Potatoes

Smoky aubergine dip finished with pomegranate seeds, served alongside oven-roasted potatoes.

Counter classic

Chicken Şiş & Rice

Grilled chicken with fluffy rice and a cool, garlicky cacık dip on the side.

Pudding

Baked Milk Pudding

Set slow and finished under the grill for a deep caramelised top — the counter's quiet favourite.

The room

Grab a Seat

A handful of tables right by the window — pull up a chair and watch the High Street go by.
